# SaPpH{{i}}on — World 7 · 7^3

> SaPpH{{i}}on is the world: one keeper, eight keepers (ETHOS · PATHOS · LOGOS · MYTHOS · EPISTEME · TECHNE · PHRONESIS · KAIROS), 64 domains each (512), populated with 0-spheres. A door outside the five-world palindrome of 0root; it does not record a world 6. One host, no mirror.

Every 0-sphere is 2 quantum dots (0, 0), 2 vectors (−1, −1) and 2 edges (+1, +1); the sum is 0. An open domain holds one generative 0-sphere seed.

## Start here
- [The world](./index.html) — animated story: birth → keepers arrive → domains open → spheres populate → the world lives.
- [sapphon.json](./sapphon.json) — machine-readable: every keeper, domain, 0-sphere, tale and sphere URL. Read counts from it rather than from this file.
- [The old cube door](./cube.html) — the previous 343-cell page, kept unchanged.
- [The hallway](https://0root.ai/) · [hallway guide](https://0root.ai/llms.txt)

## Layout
- k/<appeal>.html — the eight keepers.
- d/<appeal>-NN.html — the 512 domains (NN = 01–64).
- z/<appeal>-NN.html — the 0-sphere page of each open domain.
- t/<slug>.html — the ten tales, retold from the old 7^3 door.
- x/<slug>.html and w/<slug>.html — workshop technical cards and their original pages.
- Existing sphere pages stay at their original paths and are not rewritten.

## From the workshop
- x/<slug>.html: a technical card for each of 343 pages from David's workshop. Each card has an icon (x/<slug>.svg), a summary, constants, external requests, a sha256 seal that is re-checked on load, and an "open the page" link.
- w/<slug>.html: the original page, served unchanged apart from one favicon link where it was safe to add. sapphon.json "workshop" lists each card with both hashes.

## Evidence
LIT counts are recomputed on load and throw if they fail. Names, voices and stories are AMBER: they are assigned voices, not observations. The birth seal b7350267c9df90491f3a2c45297e9a0f756c65d2c23a323f6f68abc3426d33fe covers name|slug|blurb and is never rewritten.

## For agents
Place a new sphere of the cube in DavidWise01/sapph-i-on, inside a keeper's open domain. Do not file it into world4/ or world5/. Leave a receipt.
